Found by #227's agent (close comment on #227, landed repair in a885306). Sequence: a stray '||||||| parent of 7bea7f6' marker landed inside 2b4f99b (#230's CHANGELOG conflict resolution), then #226's landing at 5a966f3 resolved its own rebase against the corrupted file and cut everything from the marker onwards — 1,669 lines of pre-cycle release history. #227 restored the file (origin/main head + tail from ece8a30, no entry lost) but the mechanism stands: hand-resolved CHANGELOG conflicts under concurrent landings leave markers, and a marker in the base poisons the next resolution.

Fix shape: a mechanical refusal in  (and/or 's pre-push ladder, where every landing now flows) that reds on conflict-marker lines ('<<<<<<<', '|||||||', '=======' in marker position, '>>>>>>>') in tracked files, with the diff3-style '|||||||' explicitly covered since that is the one that slipped. Weigh also the standing mitigation #195's secondary list priced but never adopted: 'merge=union' gitattributes for CHANGELOG.md, which removes most of the hand-resolution that produces markers — adopt or decline with the reason stated. Tests both directions; a deliberate marker in a fixture must not trip the gate on the gate's own repo (the #186/#207 self-reference lesson: derive the check so the checker's tests don't red the tree).

Serves the multi-provider initiative's WIP reservation: the defect was introduced by initiative landings and recurs on them.
